name: HR employee View Attendance reports
query:
SELECT
    name AS "ID:Link/Project Attendance:150",
    project_name AS "Project Name::180",
    work_team AS "Work Team::180",
    project_client AS "Project / Client::180",
    task AS "Task::180",
    creation AS "Created On:Datetime:160"
FROM
    `tabProject Attendance`
ORDER BY
    creation DESC;
